recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

After a hard-fought match, South Korea's Park Taejoon secured gold in the men's -58kg taekwondo finals at Paris 2024, while Azerbaijan's Gashim Magomedov claimed silver. France's Cyrian Ravet and Tunisia's Mohamed Khalil Jendoubi shared the bronze medals.

recentItems.title: The Olympic Debut of Breaking 🧢🥇 | Paris 2024 Highlights
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Breaking made its Olympic debut at the Summer Youth Olympic Games Buenos Aires 2018 with three events: two individual events and one mixed team event. After seeing breaking's immense popularity at Buenos Aires 2018, the Paris 2024 Organising Committee proposed its inclusion for a full Olympic debut in the French capital. The IOC approved its addition to the Paris 2024 program in 2020.
